parts.target: A **HERETIC ASTARTES JUMP PACK** unit of yours that is in Reserves.
parts.effect: Place the unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" horizontally from every enemy unit; it cannot declare a charge for the rest of the turn. Then pick an **INFANTRY** or **MOUNTED** enemy unit up to 9" from the unit and [visible](vsdata:core-rule/visibility) to it: that enemy unit has to make a [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock).

Then pick an **INFANTRY** or **MOUNTED** enemy unit up to 9" from the unit and [visible](vsdata:core-rule/visibility) to it: that enemy unit has to make a [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock).
